WITH ranked_accounts AS (
    SELECT a.accindex AS account_id,
           m.netinflscore AS overall_reach_score,
           c.postfreq AS posting_frequency,
           COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY m.clustsize) AS cluster_member_count,
           RANK() OVER (ORDER BY m.netinflscore DESC) AS influence_rank
    FROM account AS a
    JOIN profile AS p ON p.profaccref = a.accindex
    JOIN sessionbehavior AS s ON s.sessprofref = p.profkey
    JOIN contentbehavior AS c ON c.cntsessref = s.sessref
    JOIN moderationaction AS m ON m.macntref = c.cntref
    WHERE m.clustrole = 'Amplifier'
      AND m.coordscore > 0.8
      AND m.netinflscore > 80
      AND c.postfreq > 30
)
SELECT account_id, overall_reach_score, posting_frequency,
       cluster_member_count, influence_rank
FROM ranked_accounts
WHERE influence_rank <= 10
ORDER BY overall_reach_score DESC
